title: Tippy content pack manifest
description: Every content/packs/<id>/manifest.json is checked against this. See backend/packs.py.

version.description: Semantic versioning, so a future update can tell packs apart.

age_range.description: [youngest, oldest] age this pack's content is written for.

generated.description: true for a pack that is built at runtime from a family's own settings (for example family-words) rather than shipped as files.

files.description: role name -> filename in this pack's own folder. May be empty for a generated pack.
